claims.text: The resort is on Lake Las Vegas, minutes from the Las Vegas Strip.

findings.quote: a tranquil Lake Las Vegas hotel offering luxury accommodations and resort-style amenities minutes from the Las Vegas Strip

claims.text: Guest rooms and suites have lake views.

findings.quote: Unwind in spacious guest rooms and suites with soothing décor, modern technology, and lake views.

claims.text: Accommodation options include suites and Casbah Villas.

findings.quote: Book a luxurious Lake Las Vegas suite or Casbah Villa in Henderson and enjoy breathtaking views.

claims.text: The resort has the two-level Nuala Pool.

findings.quote: Lounge at the two-level Nuala Pool

claims.text: A whirlpool sits next to the upper-level pool.

claims.text: By the lower-level pool there is a basketball court and a mini-golf area.

findings.quote: Nearby, join a pickup basketball game or improve your putting on our mini-golf area.

claims.text: Ah Spa by Ageless Humans is on site.

findings.quote: Rejuvenate at the new Ah Spa by Ageless Humans at The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa.

claims.text: Marssa Restaurant serves Certified Angus Beef and Wagyu steaks with lake and mountain views.

findings.quote: Treat yourself to fine dining at Marssa Restaurant, our restaurant in Henderson, NV, serving Certified Angus Beef and Wagyu steaks. Dine in an elegant setting with stunning lake and mountain views
Yes, pets are welcome at The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa.

findings.quote: Our hotel near Lake Mead National Recreation Area offers year-round activities

findings.quote: Visit the upper-level pool and take in views of the lake and beach from a comfortable lounge chair, or rent a private cabana for a more pampered experience.
